status: prespecified before opening candidate QA files or model training

dataset.train_rule: Only official train stories from other rights-verified origins. Never official validation/test stories, observed NarrativeQA books, or validation/test labels.
dataset.split_rationale: Whole origin collections selected using metadata counts only. Small heldout collections permit full-book retrieval evaluation. This is a custom source-origin holdout, not the standard published benchmark.
dataset.duplicate_rule: Before training, remove train stories with identical normalized text or title to heldout stories; report token-shingle overlap and remove train stories with Jaccard >= 0.8. Never inspect test answers to decide exclusions.
dataset.rights_gate: Verify source collection author/editor/translator and public-domain status before use. Exclusions are recorded before opening QA; dataset edits have their own exact section offsets. No source text or answers committed.

generator.name: facebook/bart-base
generator.selection: Highest validation token F1 among epoch checkpoints; tie chooses earlier epoch. No test access until serialized selection.

hypotheses: Supervised narrative answer generation improves validation answer F1 over the same untuned BART and current extractive MiniLM with identical retrieved evidence.
Question-section cross-encoder adaptation using only train evidence labels improves validation evidence recall over BM25 and the frozen pretrained reranker.

Training with retrieved contexts plus linked sections improves retrieval-context robustness relative to gold-linked-only training. If training budget permits a second generator, compare on validation only.

retrieval.scope: All sections of the question's story; never supply gold section IDs at inference.
retrieval.baseline: BM25 top 4 sections, source-order assembly, tokenizer truncation at 1024 including question
retrieval.learned: Rerank BM25 top 12 with pinned MiniLM cross-encoder, optionally fine-tuned on train positive evidence sections and same-story hard negatives. Nonlinked negatives may contain valid alternative evidence; disclose annotation incompleteness.
retrieval.selection: Validation evidence recall@4; ties choose frozen simpler policy. Report post-tokenization retained evidence recall as well.

evaluation.primary: Macro question answer normalized token F1 on retrieved contexts
evaluation.references: Nonempty answer 1 and answer 4 only, max over references; report reference-count strata.
evaluation.oracle: Human linked context is a separately labeled diagnostic, never the primary retrieval score.
evaluation.test_gate: Preparation may stage test CSV without human inspection. Training/selection runner cannot parse test questions or gold until validation selection is serialized and hashed. Test evaluation runs once after selection; later reuse is retrospective.
evaluation.no_answer: FairytaleQA is answerable-only. No claim of unknown-question calibration.
evaluation.historical: Dorian, Persuasion, Call of the Wild, Journey and Cask are observed; no selection or fresh claims from them.

provenance: exact model revision and loaded tensor hashes
QA head or generator loading audit
limitations: Source fairy tales may have appeared in model pretraining. This study does not prove pretraining decontamination.
Whole collection separation does not guarantee disjoint recurring plots.
Children's narrative adaptation is not proof of adult novel thematic reasoning.
A generated answer with retrieved section citations is not necessarily entailed by them; citation source validity and human-annotated evidence relevance are distinct metrics.
